title: Rainium
body:
Rainium: Make it Pour Performance
Rainium is a high-performance Minecraft modpack designed to squeeze every frame out of your hardware. By optimizing the rendering engine and streamlining background processes, Rainium can provide a 2x to 4x increase in FPS compared to vanilla Minecraft.

Whether you are building massive technical projects or want to run high-end shaders with ease, Rainium provides the stability and speed you need.

Key Features
- Massive FPS Boosts: Includes industry-standard optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight to ensure your game runs as smoothly as possible.

- Shader Support out of the Box: Experience beautiful visuals without the typical performance hit.

- Improved Memory Management: Reduces stuttering and lag spikes, especially during world generation or in hardware-intensive areas.

- Lightweight Design: No unnecessary bloat—only the essential mods required for peak performance.
